changeSet.author: dossier
changeSet.comment: Backfill org_assignment PRIMARY rows for seated consultants that have an ACTIVE marketer assignment and no open PRIMARY row.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO org_assignment (org_id, consultant_member_id, assignee_member_id, kind, starts_at, reason, created_by_member_id, created_at, updated_at, health) SELECT ma.org_id, cp.member_id, ma.marketer_member_id, 'PRIMARY', ma.assigned_at, 'backfill from marketer_assignment', COALESCE(ma.assigned_by_member_id, ma.marketer_member_id), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 'OK' FROM marketer_assignment ma JOIN consultant_profile cp ON cp.org_id = ma.org_id AND cp.id = ma.consultant_id WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cp.member_id IS NOT NULL AND cp.member_id <> ma.marketer_member_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_assignment oa WHERE oa.org_id = ma.org_id AND oa.consultant_member_id = cp.member_id AND oa.kind = 'PRIMARY' AND oa.ends_at IS NULL)

INSERT INTO org_assignment (org_id, consultant_member_id, assignee_member_id, kind, starts_at, reason, created_by_member_id, created_at, updated_at, health) SELECT ma.org_id, cp.member_id, ma.backup_member_id, 'BACKUP', ma.assigned_at, 'backfill from marketer_assignment', COALESCE(ma.assigned_by_member_id, ma.backup_member_id), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 'OK' FROM marketer_assignment ma JOIN consultant_profile cp ON cp.org_id = ma.org_id AND cp.id = ma.consultant_id WHERE ma.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ma.backup_member_id IS NOT NULL AND cp.member_id IS NOT NULL AND cp.member_id <> ma.backup_member_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_assignment oa WHERE oa.org_id = ma.org_id AND oa.consultant_member_id = cp.member_id AND oa.kind = 'BACKUP' AND oa.ends_at IS NULL)
